title: Процесс или Результат? (Сортировка)
description: Распредели предложения в две группы: Future Perfect (Результат/Количество) и Future Perfect Continuous (Процесс/Длительность).

items.verb: I will have downloaded 5 apps by 5 PM.
I will have been downloading this app for an hour by 5 PM.
She will have written three emails by noon.
She will have been writing emails all morning by noon.
They will have played 2 matches by 6 PM.
They will have been playing for 2 hours by 6 PM.
